summary: The delegates vote on the least they will accept before their negotiator returns with new terms.
realLife: Moran reported that Bob Moses put the Green proposal to the Freedom Democrats and received unanimous assent before the administration’s new offer arrived.
gates: A delegation can set terms for a pending negotiation.
inGame: needs: the caucus vote and the negotiating instructions in force at the time of the offer.

turns.what: The negotiator asks which terms can be traded.
turns.pulledBy: The caucus divides on one condition.
turns.writesBack: The minutes distinguish fixed instructions from discretion.

turns.what: The negotiator can bring back a proposal for a fresh vote.
turns.writesBack: No offer is recorded as accepted on the group’s behalf.
